profile.headline: Senior Product Software Engineer | C#, Cloud Applications
profile.summary: Results-driven Senior Software Engineer with 27+ years of full-stack development, cloud architecture, and technical leadership—including 15 years of continuous growth at a single forward-thinking edtech company, evolving alongside emerging technologies and complex business demands. Expert in .NET Core/ .NET 8 / .NET 9, C#, Entity Framework Core, TypeScript, AWS (ECS, Aurora, Serverless), microservices, and CI/CD pipelines. Successfully collaborated on large-scale cloud migrations, data modernizations (MSSQLto PostgreSQL/Aurora for major cost savings), infrastructure optimizations for performance and global scalability, and delivery of high-impact features such as student efficacy reports, standards mastery content, rewards systems, and teacher-created challenges—driving improved user outcomes and system reliability. Proven mentor skilled in Agile, TDD (NUnit/XUnit/Playwright), clean architecture, and cross-functional collaboration in fully remote/distributed environments. Passionate about delivering clean, maintainable, enterprise-grade solutions that scale effortlessly. Eager to bring proven expertise to innovative, high-impact teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Mentored and onboarded engineers, enforcing modern design patterns, coding standards, infrastructure as code (including Terraform), YAML configurations, and thorough code reviews, accelerating team velocity and maintaining high code quality in a fully remote environment.
•	Collaborated with architecture and dev teams to migrate legacy on-premises application to AWS cloud (ECS microservices, serverless components) using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and automation, significantly reducing operational costs, boosting global performance, scalability, and 99.9%+ availability for international users.
•	Integrated administration, teacher, and student applications through microservices and serverless architecture on AWS ECS, leveraging Docker (with YAML-based compose and task definitions) for containerization and enabling real-time data synchronization and seamless cross-app experiences in edtech platform.
•	Collaborated with enterprise-wide adoption of test-driven development (TDD) with NUnit, XUnit, and Playwright, increasing test coverage, minimizing production defects, and enabling confident, frequent releases.
•	Partnered with Data Engineering on migration from MSSQL to PostgreSQL (AWS Aurora), eliminating licensing fees, optimizing AWS costs, and improving query performance.
•	Worked with team members with Azure DevOps for end-to-end CI/CD pipelines (YAML-based), boards, tickets, and Git source control; participated in planning for GitHub migration, utilized GitHub Copilot to enhance code review speed, performance optimizations, and reduce technical debt.
•	Co-led development of internal billing API suite, integrating Salesforce quotes and invoicing APIs to automate end-to-end workflows, eliminate manual accounting errors, and streamline financial processes.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Test Driven Development · Git · Agile Methodologies · C# · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Angular · Azure DevOps Services · Cloud Applications · .NET Core · Docker · Amazon Aurora · PostgreSQL · Microsoft Copilot · GitHub Copilot · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed high-traffic corporate travel solutions using Java, Stripes, JSP, jQuery, Struts, and Spring MVC.
•	Engineered interactive, responsive web UIs for shopping, profile management, site administration, configuration, and multi-brand support, delivering superior user experiences under peak loads.
•	Established robust CI/CD practices with JBoss, Maven, Hudson/Jenkins, and comprehensive automated testing (JUnit, FitNesse, Selenium), ensuring code quality and accelerated, reliable deployments.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Built enterprise telemarketing and asset management applications using Java, JSP, XHTML, XML, JavaScript, and Struts, centralizing expense tracking, billing reconciliation, and web-based reporting.
•	Delivered MONIES suite to minimize billing discrepancies, optimize internal ordering, and provide intuitive web-accessible financial statements for U.S. enterprises.

positions.title: Senior Web Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Participated in design, development, and team delivery of scalable e-commerce platforms for multiple clients/markets using HTML, XML, CSS, JSP, Java Servlets, and EJBs.
•	Implemented template-driven architectures with strong server-side processing to meet diverse client needs efficiently.
